newsitem.title: INDIA: Last rites of Indian air crash victims held.
newsitem.headline: Last rites of Indian air crash victims held.

text.p: Last rites for the 41 unclaimed bodies of victims of the world's worst midair collision took place on Wednesday, the Press Trust of India (PTI) said.
On November 12, a Saudi Arabian jumbo jet taking off from New Delhi and an incoming Kazakh airliner smashed into each other, killing 349 people.
The 41 bodies left unclaimed in Delhi hospitals were cremated or buried, PTI said.
The bodies of those identified as Hindus were taken to a south Delhi cremation ground while those identified as Moslem victims were taken to a burial ground in North Delhi, PTI said.
